concerns.text: T015c (Validate Age/Gender Metadata) and T015d (Covariate Fallback) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depend on T015 (Data Ingestion) which is also marked [P]. However, T015c explicitly consumes the output of T015 (`valid_subjects.json`), and T015d depends on T015c's output. While T015c and T015d are sequential to T015, marking them [P] implies they can run in parallel with T015 or each other, which is false. T015c must wait for T015 to generate `valid_subjects.json`. T015d must wait for T015c to determine exclusion counts. The [P] tag is incorrect for T015c and T015d.

T018b (Halt on Zero Effective Subjects) depends on T015c (Covariate Exclusion) and T018a (Motion Exclusion). T018b is marked [P], but it requires the *results* of T015c and T018a to determine if N=0. It cannot run in parallel with them. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T016c (Halt on Zero Valid Subjects) depends on T015. It is marked [P], but it must wait for T015 to generate `valid_subjects.json` to check the count. It cannot run in parallel with T015. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T019a (Verify Preprocessing Stats) depends on T017b (Preprocessing Wrapper). It is marked [P], but it must wait for T017b to generate `preprocessing_stats.json`. It cannot run in parallel with T017b. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T031a (Validate Presence of Fluid Intelligence for US3) depends on T015 (Data Ingestion) and T026 (Graph Metrics). It is marked [P], but it must wait for both upstream tasks to complete and generate their artifacts. It cannot run in parallel with them. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T031b (Halt on Zero Valid Scores) depends on T031a. It is marked [P], but it must wait for T031a to generate `us3_validation.json`. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T031d (Multiple Linear Regression) depends on T015c and T015d. It is marked [P], but it must wait for the covariate exclusion logic to complete. It cannot run in parallel with T015c. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T032 (Bonferroni Correction) depends on T031c (Correlation Analysis). It is marked [P], but it must wait for T031c to generate correlation results. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T033 (Calculate Effect Sizes) depends on T032. It is marked [P], but it must wait for T032 to generate adjusted p-values. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T034 (Generate Scatter Plot) depends on T033. It is marked [P], but it must wait for T033 to generate `correlation_results.csv`. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T035 (Generate Summary Report) depends on T034. It is marked [P], but it must wait for T034 to generate the scatter plot. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T036 (Generate Resource Profile) is marked [P] but implies execution of the full analysis pipeline to measure resource usage. It depends on the completion of T031-T035. It cannot run in parallel with the analysis tasks. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T017c (Execute Preprocessing Pipeline) depends on T017b. It is marked [P], but it must wait for T017b to be implemented and ready to execute. While execution can be parallel to *other* tasks, the task description implies a sequential flow (T017b -> T017c). If T017c is meant to be the *execution* step, it cannot be parallel to the *implementation* step T017b if they are in the same file or share state. More critically, T017c generates an artifact that T019a consumes. The [P] tag on T017c is ambiguous and potentially misleading if it implies independence from T017b's completion.

T018a (Motion Artifact Detection) depends on T017a (Preprocessing). It is marked [P], but it must wait for T017a to generate preprocessed NIfTI files. It cannot run in parallel with T017a. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T017b (Preprocessing Wrapper) depends on T017a. It is marked [P], but it must wait for T017a to be implemented. It cannot run in parallel with T017a. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T015b (Error Message Transition) depends on T015. It is marked [P], but it must wait for T015 to be implemented to modify its error paths. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T015d (Covariate Fallback) depends on T015c. It is marked [P], but it must wait for T015c to determine exclusion counts. It cannot run in parallel. The [P] tag is incorrect.
